newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eletrobras starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eletrobras starts as buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it had started coverage of Brazilian electricity holding Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras SA, or Eletrobras, with a rating of buy.

-- "A 'break-up' analysis is the best means for valuing Eletrobras' shares, given (recent privatizations of state power comapanies), the Brazilian government's strong determination to sell the company's generating assets, and the large pool of international capital" poised to go into the electric sector.
-- The company's shares were up two reais to 417 reais in Sao Paulo.
